meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

copy.tagline: 管理 shadcn 组件和项目，添加、搜索、修复、调试和组合 UI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 shadcn/ui 构建 React 界面，需要管理组件和项目配置
copy.tagline_en: Manage shadcn components and projects: add, search, fix, debug, and compose UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build React UIs with shadcn/ui and need to manage components and project config

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你管理 shadcn/ui 组件：添加、搜索、修复、调试、样式和组合 UI，包括聊天界面。它会提供项目上下文、组件文档和使用示例。
howto.when: 当你在处理 shadcn/ui 项目、组件注册表、预设代码，或项目中有 components.json 文件时触发。也适用于“shadcn init”、“create an app with --preset”或“switch to --preset”等操作。

say.text: 帮我添加一个按钮组件到项目里。
say.note: Claude 会运行 CLI 命令添加组件。

say.text: 搜索一下有没有可用的表单组件。
say.note: Claude 会运行搜索命令并列出结果。

say.text: 帮我修复这个对话框组件的导入错误。
say.note: Claude 会检查组件并修复问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage shadcn/ui components: add, search, fix, debug, style, and compose UI, including chat interfaces. It provides project context, component docs, and usage examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when working with shadcn/ui projects, component registries, presets, or any project with a components.json file. Also for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

say_en.text: Add a button component to the project.
say_en.note: Claude runs the CLI command to add the component.
Claude runs the search command and lists results.

say_en.text: Fix the import error in this dialog component.
say_en.note: Claude inspects the component and fixes issues.
